items.stem: A finance team wants answers grounded in its own policy documents without retraining a model. Which approach fits best?

options.text: Retrieval-augmented generation over the policy documents
options.rationale: Correct: RAG grounds responses in retrieved organisational content without changing model weights.

options.text: Fine-tune a model every time a policy changes
options.rationale: Fine-tuning is costly and slow for frequently changing documents and does not provide citations by itself.

options.text: Use a larger context window and paste nothing
options.rationale: Context size without the documents provides no grounding.

items.explanation: Correct: RAG grounds responses in retrieved organisational content without changing model weights.

items.stem: Which TWO are cost drivers you should include when estimating generative AI usage costs? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Number of input and output tokens processed
options.rationale: Correct: the outline names tokens as a cost driver.

options.text: Volume of requests and chosen model
options.rationale: Correct: request volume multiplied by per-model token pricing drives spend.

options.text: The number of slides in the business case
options.rationale: Presentation length does not affect AI usage cost.

options.text: The colour theme of the Copilot interface
options.rationale: UI settings have no cost effect.

items.explanation: Correct: the outline names tokens as a cost driver.
